input.encoding: Each node is [signed value, left child index, right child index]; -1 means absent. The query is passed separately as root index and inclusive low/high bounds.
input.root_index: The root may be at any node-table index; an empty tree uses -1.
input.tree_requirement: A valid, nonempty or empty rooted binary search tree with unique values; every node must be reachable exactly once.
input.result: Sum values in the inclusive interval [low, high].
